subject.title: [Bug]: Assistant text preceding a tool call in the same turn is silently dropped on Signal channel (Anthropic/Sonnet, non-streaming)

question: For source-channel `toolUse` turns that contain text before a tool call, should OpenClaw keep that text private with an agent-visible undelivered marker, deliver selected pre-tool text, or require explicit message-tool delivery for confirmations?
rationale: Current main has a credible harmful blind spot, but delivering all pre-tool text conflicts with the existing policy that protects messaging channels from internal narration leaks.

options.title: Mark suppressed text undelivered
options.body: Keep commentary suppression for leak prevention while making provider replay tell the model that the text was not seen by the user.

options.title: Deliver selected pre-tool text
options.body: Flush only confidently user-facing pre-tool text and add tests proving internal narration still cannot leak to channels.

options.title: Require explicit message delivery
options.body: Document bare pre-tool text as private and require `message(action=send)` or an equivalent explicit send path for user-visible confirmations.

recommendation.title: Mark suppressed text undelivered
recommendation.body: Keep commentary suppression for leak prevention while making provider replay tell the model that the text was not seen by the user.

likelyOwner.reason: They have the strongest recent history across the subscriber and payload code that would enforce the chosen contract.
